title: Exact inverse envelope for unequal row contraction budgets
body:
This scoped proof gives the exact worst column norm of an inverse under unequal row contraction budgets and a fixed directed support. Maximum-product paths give an attaining matrix for every column. It extends the uniform-budget result without imposing a common worst row gap. The complete kappa calculation is unchanged.

[Proof and scope](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1ff5044ee4805e0e24afb8e3067a50435745a538/research/unequal-row-resolvent/README.md), [exact checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1ff5044ee4805e0e24afb8e3067a50435745a538/research/unequal-row-resolvent/verify.py), [replay declaration](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1ff5044ee4805e0e24afb8e3067a50435745a538/research/unequal-row-resolvent/VERIFY.json), and [source provenance](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1ff5044ee4805e0e24afb8e3067a50435745a538/research/unequal-row-resolvent/SOURCES.json) are pinned to the reviewed commit. Base: canonical main `ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf`, priority revision 7.

The initial proof and standalone check are in [Discussion #5290](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5290).

CPython 3.12.14 registered normal and optimized replays passed: 5,259 attaining columns, 282 signed matrices and seven controls. Both print `PASS_UNEQUAL_ROW_ENVELOPE`; the launcher prints `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. All five package files match their committed bytes, and the base is an ancestor of the package commit.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/unequal-row-resolvent
```

Use Python 3.12 and the standard library. No external runtime inputs or third-party Python packages are required. Hosted planning and the registered package replay passed on this exact head in [run 39989924902](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39989924902). No predecessor scientific suite, selected cold replay, native replay, compiler, Lean or Docker build was run. The optional full-history preflight is unavailable in this shallow checkout. Finite checks corroborate the written proof; they do not constitute independent human or proof-kernel acceptance.

Extract unequal rational row budgets from one emitted coefficient matrix and charge their preparation. Source preparation, native operations, precision, movement, and supplier/outer admission remain separate obligations.

Credit Ali Romman's [PR #5255](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5255) for the uniform support optimum, Cinna Davis's [PR #4100](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4100) for the conditioning context, and James Reed's [PR #4282](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4282) for periodic sections. Neumann-series, maximum-principle, and optimal-path methods are classical. Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. No general literature-priority or independent human/proof-kernel acceptance is claimed.
